title: Update a task
description: Returns HTTP 200 with the updated task. Include version to guard against overwrites; a stale version returns 409 with the current task. Invalid status or priority returns 400.

sections.title: Behavior
paragraphs: Returns HTTP 200 with the updated task. Include version to guard against overwrites; a stale version returns 409 with the current task. Invalid status or priority returns 400.

sections.title: Related routes
paragraphs: POST /api/tasks/{id}/claim assigns the task, returning 409 if someone else holds it. POST /api/tasks/{id}/done closes it. DELETE /api/tasks/{id} removes it and returns 204.
